identity.name: Identity to Endpoint to Network Hands-on-Keyboard Campaign — Cross-Plane XSIAM Stitch (T1078 / T1059 / T1071)
identity.summary: A single social-engineered account takeover fans out across three planes: an anomalous IdP sign-in (ITDR), hands-on-keyboard living-off-the-land activity on the endpoint (EDR), then C2 egress (NDR). No stage is a known-bad IOC on its own; XSIAM fuses the two behavioral ABIOCs and the egress signal into ONE incident anchored to the shared identity-host-session chain.
identity.description: This scenario proves the flagship Cortex correlation narrative on the ANALYTICS plane: a staged intrusion that no single detection plane would confidently escalate, stitched into one incident by XSIAM's causality engine. It models the signature identity-driven tradecraft attributed to Scattered Spider / Muddled Libra (UNC3944) and Octo Tempest — social-engineered credential + MFA-fatigue takeover of a privileged/service account, followed by interactive hands-on-keyboard work on a reachable host, then attacker-controlled egress. Stage one is an ITDR sign-in anomaly: the same account authenticates from an improbable geography while a burst of MFA challenges is pushed at it (MFA request generation / fatigue). Stage two is an EDR behavioral deviation: the account, whose learned Cortex profile is narrow non-interactive automation, suddenly parents an interactive shell and runs a rapid living-off-the-land discovery burst (whoami, id, uname, hostname, ss). Stage three is an NDR signal: repetitive low-and-slow outbound sessions to an attacker-staging destination. Two auto-tuned ABIOCs cover the identity and endpoint behavioral shapes; a validation XQL confirms the C2 egress burst on the NGFW; a second validation XQL asserts the cross-plane convergence; and a correlation rule (CR-MP-0013) joins all three planes on the shared identity/host/session entity within a 300-second window into a single hands-on-keyboard-campaign incident. The point is F2 cross-plane coverage: every individual binary and session is legitimate in isolation — the escalation comes from the behavioral deviations plus the stitched causality chain (anomalous auth -> interactive shell + discovery burst -> C2 egress), not any static signature. The DC presents the single stitched incident as proof that Cortex correlates identity, endpoint, and network telemetry into one causality graph where point tools would raise three disconnected, individually-dismissable low-severity alerts.

campaigns: Identity-driven hands-on-keyboard intrusions across SaaS, endpoint, and network planes in enterprise and hybrid estates (2022-2026)

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-MP-008 — Identity-to-endpoint-to-network hands-on-keyboard campaign stitched into one XSIAM incident (F2 cross-plane correlation)

prerequisites.description: Cortex XSIAM ingesting all three planes: an IdP sign-in dataset (okta_sso), endpoint process telemetry (xdr_data), and NGFW traffic (panw_ngfw_traffic_raw), so the correlation engine can join them.

A baseline window has elapsed during which the account produced only its normal sign-in geography and non-interactive automation on the host, so Cortex learned both the identity and endpoint behavioral profiles.

payload.code:
# No known-bad payloads. Drive a takeover fan-out across three planes:
# (1) identity sign-in anomaly marker, (2) hands-on-keyboard endpoint burst,
# (3) repetitive C2 egress. Every command is a legitimate admin action.
set -euo pipefail
# (1) identity stage marker (the IdP anomaly is emitted by the ITDR path)
echo 'cortexsim-mp-008-idp-signin-anomaly'
# (2) hands-on-keyboard living-off-the-land discovery burst
for c in 'whoami' 'id' 'uname -a' 'hostname' 'ss -tunlp'; do sh -c "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done
# (3) repetitive outbound C2 egress to an authorised staging host
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do curl -s --max-time 5 "http://${C2_HOST:-127.0.0.1}/beacon?i=$i" -o /dev/null 2>/dev/null || true; done

input_variables.name: C2_HOST
input_variables.description: Authorised staging host the repetitive egress reaches during the C2 stage.

expected_artifacts.description: An IdP sign-in for the account from an improbable geography accompanied by a burst of MFA challenges, deviating from the account's learned sign-in profile.
An interactive shell plus a discovery burst under the same account on the endpoint whose learned baseline is non-interactive automation.
Repetitive outbound sessions from the same host to an attacker-staging destination.

abiocs.name: MP-008 Identity Sign-In Anomaly on a Privileged Account
abiocs.description: A privileged/service account whose learned Cortex sign-in profile is a narrow, stable geography authenticates successfully from an improbable second country while a burst of MFA challenges is pushed at it. The ABIOC anchors the impossible-travel-plus-MFA-fatigue deviation to the account's learned baseline rather than to any single failed logon, catching the social-engineered takeover front-end of a Scattered Spider / Octo Tempest intrusion.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = okta_sso
| filter eventType = "user.authentication.sso" or eventType = "user.mfa.factor.activate" or eventType = "user.mfa.factor.challenge"
| filter actor_alternate_id in ("svc-backup", "www-data", "nobody")
| comp count_distinct(client_geo_country) as countries, count() as mfa_prompts by actor_alternate_id
| filter countries >= 2 and mfa_prompts >= 5
| sort desc mfa_prompts
| fields actor_alternate_id, countries, mfa_prompts
abiocs.causality_anchor: Learned per-identity sign-in baseline (stable geography, low MFA-prompt volume) -> a successful authentication from an improbable geography coupled with an MFA-challenge burst, anchored to the identity so the takeover is the root of the causality chain.

abiocs.name: MP-008 Hands-on-Keyboard Endpoint Behavioral Deviation
abiocs.description: Immediately after the anomalous sign-in, the same account, whose learned endpoint baseline is narrow non-interactive automation, parents an interactive shell and runs a rapid living-off-the-land discovery burst. Every utility is a legitimate admin tool; the ABIOC fires on the interactive-lineage-plus-diversity deviation from the account's learned process profile, anchored to the shell that spawned the burst.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_effective_username in ("svc-backup", "www-data", "nobody")
| filter action_process_image_name in ("bash", "sh", "whoami", "id", "uname", "hostname", "ss", "netstat", "curl")
| comp count_distinct(action_process_image_name) as distinct_tools, count() as burst by agent_hostname, actor_effective_username
| filter distinct_tools >= 4
| sort desc distinct_tools
| fields agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, distinct_tools, burst
abiocs.causality_anchor: Anomalous account sign-in -> interactive shell under the same account on a reachable host -> rapid fan-out of distinct discovery utilities exceeding the account's learned process diversity, anchored to the spawning shell and the originating identity.

xql_queries.name: MP-008 C2 Egress Session Burst From the Compromised Host
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 900)
| filter app in ("web-browsing", "ssl", "http")
| comp count() as sessions by source_ip, dest_ip
| filter sessions >= 5
| sort desc sessions
| fields source_ip, dest_ip, sessions

xql_queries.name: MP-008 Cross-Plane Stitch Convergence Check
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 900)
| comp count_distinct(_product) as plane_count, count_distinct(incident_id) as incident_count by agent_hostname
| filter plane_count >= 3 and incident_count = 1
| fields agent_hostname, plane_count, incident_count

correlation_rules.name: Identity-to-Endpoint-to-Network Hands-on-Keyboard Campaign Stitch
correlation_rules.logic: ABIOC(MP-008 Identity Sign-In Anomaly on a Privileged Account) AND ABIOC(MP-008 Hands-on-Keyboard Endpoint Behavioral Deviation) AND XQL(MP-008 C2 Egress Session Burst From the Compromised Host) joined on the shared identity-host-session entity chain within a 300-second correlation window — fuses the ITDR sign-in anomaly, the EDR hands-on-keyboard behavioral deviation, and the NDR C2 egress into ONE incident_id spanning >= 3 planes (ITDR + EDR + NDR), producing the anomalous-auth -> interactive-shell-plus-discovery -> C2-egress causality chain.

Cortex XSIAM Correlation Engine — cross-plane causality stitching over identity, endpoint, and network telemetry

products.evidence_query: Two ABIOCs fire on the identity and endpoint behavioral deviations; CR-MP-0013 stitches them with the NDR C2 egress into one hands-on-keyboard-campaign incident spanning ITDR + EDR + NDR.
dataset = xdr_data | comp count_distinct(_product) as plane_count, count_distinct(incident_id) as incident_count by agent_hostname | filter plane_count >= 3 and incident_count = 1

use_cases.name: Identity-to-Endpoint-to-Network Hands-on-Keyboard Campaign Correlation
use_cases.description: XSIAM stitches an anomalous IdP sign-in, a hands-on-keyboard endpoint behavioral deviation, and attacker-controlled network egress from one compromised identity into a single causality-linked incident that point tools would only surface as three disconnected low-severity alerts.

test_cases.objective: The three staged signals from one identity/host stitch into a single incident spanning ITDR + EDR + NDR within the correlation window.
preconditions: XSIAM ingesting okta_sso, xdr_data, and panw_ngfw_traffic_raw for the target estate.
Baseline window elapsed so the identity sign-in and endpoint process profiles are learned.
steps: Emit the anomalous sign-in for the account.
Run the hands-on-keyboard discovery burst under the same account on the host.
Generate the repetitive C2 egress from the same host.
Observe both ABIOCs fire and CR-MP-0013 raise one stitched hands-on-keyboard-campaign incident.
success_criteria: ABIOC `MP-008 Identity Sign-In Anomaly on a Privileged Account` fires.
ABIOC `MP-008 Hands-on-Keyboard Endpoint Behavioral Deviation` fires.
Correlation CR-MP-0013 raises one incident_id spanning >= 3 planes (ITDR + EDR + NDR).

preventive_controls: Enforce phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2/WebAuthn) and number-matching so MFA-fatigue push bombing cannot complete the sign-in stage Scattered Spider abuses.
Deny interactive shells for service/automation accounts (set login shell to /usr/sbin/nologin and enforce via PAM) so hands-on-keyboard use of the account is blocked, not merely detected.
Enforce egress filtering / DNS control so attacker-controlled C2 destinations are unreachable from server segments.
detection_engineering: Let Cortex auto-tune ABIOCs against the learned per-identity sign-in geography and per-identity endpoint process baseline rather than hand-authoring static rules.
Correlate identity, endpoint, and network telemetry on the shared identity/host/session entity so a takeover fan-out escalates as one incident instead of three dismissable alerts.
Alert on an anomalous sign-in that is temporally followed by interactive shell activity and outbound egress from the same account/host.
